qualification.details: Internal Audit Officer: Retired officer belonging to Audit and Accounts Services or other similar organised Accounts Services in Central / State Govt., held analogous posts on regular basis. Assistant Registrar (Finance): Retired officer of Central / State Government/ Autonomous Organization/Statutory Body / University. Master's Degree in any discipline from any UGC recognized university; At least 5 years of experience in Finance & Accounts in Pay Level 10 or equivalent Scale of Pay or above Assistant Engineer (Civil): First Class Bachelor's Degree in relevant field from a recognised Institute/ University or equivalent. Three years' experience in the relevant field as Junior Engineer or Equivalent in State Government PWD services or similar organized services/ Statutory or Autonomous organization/ University System or reputed private organizations with an annual turnover of at least Rs. 200/- Crores or more.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Tripura University Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Tripura University to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Tripura University Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Tripura University Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Tripura University to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Tripura University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for Tripura University Recruitment 2026 is 09 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Tripura University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Internal Audit Officer, Assistant Registrar (Finance), and Assistant Engineer (Civil).

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for Tripura University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for Tripura University Recruitment 2026 is strictly online through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Internal Audit Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Internal Audit Officer post will receive a salary of Rs. 65,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for Assistant Engineer (Civil)?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Engineer (Civil) post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for Tripura University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, an application fee of Rs. 500 is applicable for all categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual positions will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Registrar (Finance)?
faq.answer: For Assistant Registrar (Finance), candidates need a Master's Degree and at least 5 years of experience in Finance & Accounts.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired government officers apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, retired officers from Audit and Accounts Services, Central/State Government, Universities, and Autonomous Bodies are eligible for specific posts.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the contract for these positions?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for a contractual engagement of 11 months.
